standard_prerequisites.name: The localization of a dualizing complex at a prime is a dualizing complex over the local ring
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 3456-3458)
standard_prerequisites.use: Transports the hypothesis to the local ring at the minimal prime.

standard_prerequisites.name: The shape of a dualizing complex over an Artinian local ring
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source line 3460)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives that a dualizing complex over a zero dimensional local ring has exactly one nonzero cohomology module.

core_obligations: Localize: the base change of the dualizing complex to the local ring at the minimal prime is again a dualizing complex (proof lines 3456-3458)
Observe the dimension: the local ring at a minimal prime of a Noetherian ring has dimension zero (proof lines 3459-3460)

Conclude: over a zero dimensional local ring the cited description of dualizing complexes gives that exactly one cohomology module is nonzero, and localization does not change which one (proof lines 3460-3461)
proof_roadmap: ω_A^• ⊗_A A_p 是 A_p 上的对偶复形（由对偶复形的局部化引理）。
维数为零时对偶复形只有一处非零上同调（dualizing-artinian 引理），而局部化不改变非零位置，故 H^i(ω_A^•)_p 恰有一个 i 非零。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that if A is a Noetherian ring and p a minimal prime, then the localized cohomology modules H^i(omega_A^bullet)_p of a dualizing complex vanish for all but exactly one i (author lemma at source lines 3448-3452, label lemma-nonvanishing-generically). The proof (source lines 3455-3462) localizes the dualizing complex to the local ring at p, where it stays dualizing, observes that this local ring has dimension zero because p is minimal, and invokes the description of dualizing complexes over such a ring, where exactly one cohomology module is nonzero. The localization step and the dimension observation are the substance. H2.
